summary: AAP 2.5 and later drop nested teams; a 2.4 to 2.6 upgrade flattens User → Team A → Team B into direct memberships of each team, so integrations or automation using nested teams must be changed before upgrading.
questions: What happens to nested teams when upgrading from 2.4?
Why do my team permissions look different after upgrading to 2.6?

answer_card.title: Nested teams removed in 2.5+
answer_card.answer_md:
- Nested teams (User → Team A → Team B, created via API/collections in 2.4) are not supported in 2.5+.
- The upgrade converts them to direct memberships: User → Team A and User → Team B.
- **Before upgrading**, change integrations or automation that create nested teams to use direct user-to-team mapping.
